description: Compare a proposed spend with a remaining budget, transaction ceiling and merchant allowlist, returning ALLOW/BLOCK with reasons. Budget and ceiling are independent: amount=4, remaining_budget=10, per_transaction_limit=3 returns BLOCK; equality passes. Use one currency/unit, and update remaining_budget in your application after each actual purchase: this tool neither tracks cumulative spending nor converts currencies. Omitting allowed_merchants skips merchant checks; supplying it requires an exact merchant match, and [] blocks all merchants. Use trust_check_action to include evidence or data checks. Enforce BLOCK before paying; this tool never accesses a wallet or executes payment. Free, unauthenticated, stateless pilot: rules apply only to this call. Usage metadata is recorded; request bodies are not stored.

inputSchema.description: One proposed spend and its numeric constraints.

allowed_merchants.description: Optional exact, case-sensitive merchant allowlist. An empty list blocks every merchant.

amount.description: Proposed non-negative amount. Use the same currency/unit as both limits.

merchant.description: Merchant identifier; required when allowed_merchants is supplied.

per_transaction_limit.description: Optional inclusive maximum amount per transaction.

remaining_budget.description: Caller-supplied remaining budget; never read from a wallet or persisted by this service.

name: trust_check_spend

outputSchema.description: Structured result, also serialized in the text content block.

ok.description: The operation completed; does not imply the verdict is ALLOW.

reasons.description: All failed checks; empty when ALLOW.

items.description: A deterministic finding; codes identify the violated check.

row.description: Zero-based input row index, when applicable.

verdict.description: Advisory verdict. The integrator must prevent execution on BLOCK or any error.

title: Check a proposed spend against limits
